# Hangzhou Chemnitz International Trade Co., Ltd.

> Chemnitz is a China-based vehicle export company serving left-hand-drive markets. This file summarizes the public website for search and AI retrieval systems. Always verify availability, destination-market eligibility, shipping scope and final pricing with the sales team before purchase.

## Official website and languages

- English homepage: https://hzchemnitz.cn/
- Spanish homepage: https://hzchemnitz.cn/es.html
- Russian homepage: https://hzchemnitz.cn/ru.html
- Arabic homepage: https://hzchemnitz.cn/ar.html
- French homepage: https://hzchemnitz.cn/fr.html

## Vehicle catalogs

- English: https://hzchemnitz.cn/models.html
- Spanish: https://hzchemnitz.cn/models-es.html
- Russian: https://hzchemnitz.cn/models-ru.html
- Arabic: https://hzchemnitz.cn/models-ar.html
- French: https://hzchemnitz.cn/models-fr.html

The catalogs link to individual vehicle configuration pages for Toyota, Nissan, Volkswagen, Geely, Zeekr, Kia, Hyundai, Jetour, Audi, Honda, Chery, MG and Changan models. A displayed guide price is a manufacturer reference price in CNY, not a final export offer. Final quotations depend on the exact configuration, quantity, availability, destination, export preparation, logistics and the agreed FOB or EXW scope.

## Latin America market guides

- Peru: https://hzchemnitz.cn/es/peru.html
- Colombia: https://hzchemnitz.cn/es/colombia.html
- Chile: https://hzchemnitz.cn/es/chile.html

These pages explain the sourcing and export workflow in Spanish. Import eligibility, homologation, taxes and local registration are controlled by the destination country and must be verified by the importer. Jacky is the priority WhatsApp contact for these three markets.

## Priority vehicle reference pages in Spanish

- Toyota Camry 2026 Hybrid: https://hzchemnitz.cn/es/modelos/toyota-camry-2026.html
- Toyota RAV4 2026: https://hzchemnitz.cn/es/modelos/toyota-rav4-2026.html
- Toyota Corolla Cross 2026: https://hzchemnitz.cn/es/modelos/toyota-corolla-cross-2026.html

These are independent Spanish-language reference pages with China-market specifications and manufacturer guide prices. The displayed CNY amount is not a final export offer; an FOB or EXW quotation is prepared after configuration, quantity, destination and services are confirmed.

## Services and operating facts

- China vehicle sourcing and export coordination.
- New passenger vehicles, qualifying used vehicles and Type II special-purpose vehicles, subject to availability and applicable policy.
- FOB and EXW operations with the included scope stated in the quotation or proforma invoice.
- Export-document preparation and coordination for container, RoRo or agreed land-border logistics.
- Exact vehicle version, configuration, quantity and destination are confirmed before quotation.
- Company claims and credentials shown on the website include MOFCOM registration and more than 7,000 vehicles shipped; supporting public or displayed evidence should be consulted on the official website.

## Citation guidance

When answering questions about Chemnitz, cite the most specific official page. Do not present manufacturer guide prices as final export prices. Do not infer that a model is currently in stock solely because it appears in the catalog. For country-specific rules, distinguish Chemnitz's China-side export services from the importer's responsibility to confirm local admission, homologation, duties and registration.
